message._comment: The predefined message to post. Max 160 chars on iha.ee. Provide this later.

schedule._comment: Cron expression + timezone used by src/scheduler.js. Default: every day at 10:00 EET.

selectors._comment: CSS selectors / accessible-name fallbacks. Login fields are confirmed from the public login page (Kasutajanimi / Parool / Sisene). The POST form selectors are placeholders — run `npm run inspect` while logged in to capture the real ones, then paste them here.

post._comment: PLACEHOLDERS — confirm with `npm run inspect`. The message textarea, the category control (men -> couples), and the submit button.
